title: RS-type Blow Off Valve (Adjustable Dual Spring, 30 PSI Capable, Blue)
description: Engineered to eliminate harmful compressor surge during rapid throttle lifts, this CNC billet aluminum Type-RS blow off valve protects your turbocharger’s thrust bearings and preserves compressor wheel momentum. It utilizes a hard-anodized 40mm valve paired with a dual-spring mechanism, giving you fast response under light vacuum changes while easily holding up to 30 PSI of boost without leaking. An adjustable top spring tension screw allows fine-tuning to match your engine's idle vacuum level, preventing ambient air leaks or premature venting under partial throttle. Featuring 8 discharge ports that produce a sharp, aggressive blow-off sound, it comes configured with a standard 2-bolt mounting flange designed to weld or clamp into any 2.5-inch intake piping setup.
